model: GNU BF524 with documented D-register deferred-writeback patch; not hardware validation
limitations: The internal word and choice/order of three transform callbacks are explicit inputs; the original knob conversion and complete wave-update dispatcher remain pending.
No spectral-family mixing, original voice scheduler, pitch provider, ADSR, output or plugin integration is completed by these transforms.
The supported nonnegative Q16 domain avoids out-of-range addressing branches. No arbitrary-word emulation or hardware timing claim.

validation.independent_reproduction: Two private output directories; full inputs and original outputs agree byte for byte.
validation.windows_wine: MSVC-target cross-build and drwave246_transform test passed under Wine; not native Windows/Ableton/ASIO validation.
validation.sanitizers: New transform test passed ASan+UBSan; LeakSanitizer disabled because of sandbox ptrace limitation.
validation.runtime_linkage: New header is only included by drwave246_transform_tests. Instrument executable, selector, MIDI/host parameter IDs and presets unchanged.
